description: One call that gathers what matters today across ALL accounts: unread counts, new personal emails since a time (default last 24h), how many newsletters/notifications arrived (and from whom), conversations waiting for your reply, and today's calendar events (for accounts with calendar access). Use for "morning briefing", "catch me up", "what happened since yesterday". Summarize it per account/business for the user.

account.description: Which mailbox(es): an alias, an email address, a list of them, or "all". Omit to use ALL connected accounts. No accounts connected yet.

maxNewPerAccount.description: Max new personal emails listed per account (default 10).

sinceHours.description: New mail from the last N hours (default 24).

name: daily_digest
title: Daily digest across all inboxes
